duplicates.notes: No matching published feta whip with cucumber and red pepper sticks was found in the public recipe tree.

ingredients.notes: Six measured ingredients match the internal review; 25% drained goat-milk feta and plain lactose-free 7% Greek yogurt are specified. The illustration shows the dip, dill, cucumber and red pepper.

method.notes: Blend feta, yogurt and lemon juice, stir in dill, and prepare the listed washed vegetables; all six quantities match the four portions.

food_safety.notes: Milk allergen disclosed. Wash raw produce and refrigerate covered if preparing before serving.

servings_and_time.notes: Fifteen minutes for a cold preparation. Four portions each use about 59 g dip, 50 g cucumber and 37.5 g red pepper.

nutrition.notes: Current ingredients verified against Fineli Release 20 food records 11211, 34611, 11557, 369, 346 and 386 and recalculated against the public source hash.

glycemic.notes: No preparation-matched glycemic load calculation is approved for this recipe. The recipe displays GK as undetermined.
